name: GEOG 5220
title: Geography of Sustainable Development
description: Conceptualizing international development; understanding theories, strategies and ideologies of development; and use of case studies to understand development in practice.  Emphasis placed on the concept of sustainable development and sustainability, grassroots-driven approaches to development, the role of women, and geographic explanations as to how and why uneven development has occurred.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
